type_english:
for all n : ℕ, for all Op : EllipticPdes.Sobolev.FullEllipticOp (n + 1), for all Ω : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))), for all hΩm : Ω is measurable, if Ω is open, then for all hA : EllipticPdes.Regularity.IsC1Coeff Op.toEllipticCoeff, for all V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))), if V is compact, then if V is a subset of Ω, then for all u : ↥(EllipticPdes.Sobolev.H01 Ω), for all f : EllipticPdes.Sobolev.L2D Ω, if for all w : ↥(EllipticPdes.Sobolev.H01 Ω), ((Op.fullBilin Ω) u) w equals ∫ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) in Ω, ↑↑f x * ↑↑((↑w).ofLp 0) x, then there exists C : ℝ such that 0 is at most C and for all k : Fin (n + 1), for all i : Fin (n + 1), there exists wki : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℝ 2 (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict V)) such that EllipticPdes.Regularity.HasWeakDerivOn V k
  (EllipticPdes.Regularity.restrictL2 ((EllipticPdes.Regularity.extendL2 hΩm) ((↑u).ofLp i.succ))) wki and ‖wki‖ + ‖EllipticPdes.Regularity.restrictL2 ((EllipticPdes.Regularity.extendL2 hΩm) ((↑u).ofLp i.succ))‖ +
  ‖EllipticPdes.Regularity.restrictL2 ((EllipticPdes.Regularity.extendL2 hΩm) ((↑u).ofLp 0))‖ is at most C * (‖f‖ + ‖(↑u).ofLp 0‖)
type_pp:
∀ {n : ℕ} (Op : EllipticPdes.Sobolev.FullEllipticOp (n + 1)) {Ω : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
  (hΩm : MeasurableSet Ω),
  IsOpen Ω →
    ∀ (hA : EllipticPdes.Regularity.IsC1Coeff Op.toEllipticCoeff) {V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))},
      IsCompact V →
        V ⊆ Ω →
          ∀ (u : ↥(EllipticPdes.Sobolev.H01 Ω)) (f : EllipticPdes.Sobolev.L2D Ω),
            (∀ (w : ↥(EllipticPdes.Sobolev.H01 Ω)),
                ((Op.fullBilin Ω) u) w = ∫ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) in Ω, ↑↑f x * ↑↑((↑w).ofLp 0) x) →
              ∃ C,
                0 ≤ C ∧
                  ∀ (k i : Fin (n + 1)),
                    ∃ wki,
                      EllipticPdes.Regularity.HasWeakDerivOn V k
                          (EllipticPdes.Regularity.restrictL2
                            ((EllipticPdes.Regularity.extendL2 hΩm) ((↑u).ofLp i.succ)))
                          wki ∧
                        ‖wki‖ +
                              ‖EllipticPdes.Regularity.restrictL2
                                  ((EllipticPdes.Regularity.extendL2 hΩm) ((↑u).ofLp i.succ))‖ +
                            ‖EllipticPdes.Regularity.restrictL2
                                ((EllipticPdes.Regularity.extendL2 hΩm) ((↑u).ofLp 0))‖ ≤
                          C * (‖f‖ + ‖(↑u).ofLp 0‖)
